clips.title: The story
paras: Dwarven prospectors are trapped above Whelgar's Excavation Site, cut off from their findings. The dig sought ancient Titan relics, prehistoric secrets, and fossils, but mottled raptors overran the quarry.

Between Menethil Harbor and Dun Modr, dwarven prospectors dug for ancient fossils and earthen mysteries. Their search for prehistoric remnants stirred the native mottled raptors. Overwhelmed and under-equipped, the archaeologists fled to a ridge overlooking the site. Their tents, tools, and unearthed relics remain scattered among the prowling predators.
